QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] Forbidden Creation
QuestInfo.0: Speak with Crow to find out what he knows.
QuestInfo.1: Enter the Mystic Gate with Crow and eliminate Chimera. Keep an eye out for anything suspicious.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated Chimera. Check around the area for anything odd before you leave.

0.0: I found traces of the Black Wings on my way here. I couldn't actually track them down, though.
0.1: Their trail led here, to this gate. I think we'd both better get in there. Better stay out of my way, rookie. Just watch my back, alright?

yes.0: I know you're not used to fighting at this level, so let me remind you. Hit them hard and hit them fast. I don't want to have to spend the next three hours cleaning you up off the ground.

no.0: What? Don't think I'm going to let you take all the glory!

1.0: The energy in this place is terrifying...ahem, I mean, it's weird. I think the Mystic Gate is empowering these monsters somehow, making them stronger.

npc.0: That was unsurprising. Let me know when you're done crying and we'll try again.

mob.0: Eliminate the Chimera inside the Mystic Gate!
